summary: A boxed container used to group related content together, with its own border and padding.
description: Cards contain content and actions about a single subject. The default type has no extra functionality; the "accordion" type initially hides its content behind a collapsed summary and can be expanded/collapsed by the user (or forced open via the expanded attribute).

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: The heading text used for the card.

attributes.name: headingLevel
attributes.description: Specifies whether the heading renders as h1-h6 instead of a plain span (0/unset = span).

attributes.name: iconSrc
attributes.description: Path to an optional icon shown next to the heading.

attributes.name: spacing
attributes.description: The spacing level applied to the card. Default or "compact" (reduced spacing).

attributes.name: expanded
attributes.description: For accordion cards, whether the content section is expanded on initial render (and reflects current open/closed state after user toggling).

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Optional ARIA role for the card's article element.

attributes.name: summaryTabIndex
attributes.description: Optional tabindex for the accordion summary element.

slots.name: cover-image
slots.description: Named slot for an optional cover image shown above the heading/content.

slots.name: (default)
slots.description: The card's content. Note: the class JSDoc labels this slot "content", but the rendered <slot> in both the default and accordion templates has no name attribute — it is the unnamed/default slot, not a named "content" slot.

events.name: toggle
events.description: Fired (as a ToggleEvent with newState/oldState) when an accordion-type card's expanded state changes via user interaction with the <details> element.

usage: Card content goes here.

cssParts.name: summary
cssParts.description: The <summary> element, only present when the card is expandable.
